lines.meet: ¡Qué onda, {carnal|carnala}! I'm Emiliano, pyromancer and showman. Want to see a trick?
lines.meet_neighbour: Cinderwharf, by the forges, I know your face! I'm Emiliano, and I'm the one the crowds come for.
lines.ask_home: Where are you from, {carnal|carnala}? Tell me, and make it a good story.
lines.ask_work: What was your act before all this? Everybody's got an act, {carnal|carnala}.
lines.answer_home: Oaxaca, {carnal|carnala}, the best city in Mexico. Ask anybody from Oaxaca and they'll tell you the same.
lines.answer_work: I breathed fire at the traffic lights by the zócalo for eleven years, two minutes a red light, coins through the car windows.
lines.chat_food: Tlayudas from the market, {carnal|carnala}, big as a car wheel, with a little mezcal on the side. That's real living.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep when the crowd goes home, and the crowd never goes home. So I don't sleep much.
lines.chat_missing: My four sisters, all of them shouting at me at once in my mother's kitchen. I helped raise them, and they've never once let me win an argument.
lines.chat_here: The fire here came out of me the colour of a dragon on my first try. I've been showing off ever since, and I'm not sorry.
lines.tease_quiet: {name}, {carnal|carnala}, you'd be a terrible audience. You don't clap, you don't shout, you just stand there.
lines.tease_talker: {name}, you could hold a crowd for longer than a red light, I'll give you that. Almost as long as me.
lines.tease_careful: {name}, you'd stand three metres back from a candle. Come closer, I won't burn you, probably.
lines.tease_bold: {name}, you'd jump through my fire just to see if you could. Órale, I like you already.
lines.tease_any: {name}, you're my best audience, {carnal|carnala}, and my worst. You never pay.
lines.tease_back: ¡Órale, {name}, you've got a mouth on you! I respect it.
lines.take_it_kindly: Okay, okay, {name}, that's fair. My mother says the same thing.
lines.bristle: Hey, not that one, {carnal|carnala}. Watch your mouth with that.
lines.apologise: Perdón, that was too much, even for me. I'm sorry, really.
lines.double_down: Nah, I'm keeping that one, {carnal|carnala}. It was a good line.
lines.needle_quiet: You stand at the back and never clap. Give a man something, at least.
lines.needle_talker: You talk over my act, {carnal|carnala}. Nobody talks over my act.
lines.needle_careful: You're so careful, it's painful to watch. Live a little, before you're old.
lines.needle_bold: You think you're the star out here. There's only one star, {carnal|carnala}, and it's me.
lines.needle_any: You think street performers are beggars, I can see it on your face. Eleven years and not one burn, and you look down at me.
lines.bite_back: Hey, I've held crowds you couldn't hold for ten seconds. Don't you tell me about doing my job.
lines.hurt: Fine, fine, message received. I'll keep it down for a while.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, I've had drunks at the lights say worse, {carnal|carnala}, and they still paid. Come on, let's go.
lines.confide: {name}, I paid for two of my sisters to finish school. I'm prouder of that than of any trick, and I don't tell people, because it ruins my image.
lines.listen: No show, no joke, {name}. That stays with me.
lines.look_out: When I light up in there, {name}, you want to be on my right side, so remember that.
lines.accept: Okay, {name}, your way, just this once. Don't tell anybody.
lines.deflect: I'm fine, {carnal|carnala}, look at my hands, not a mark. Eleven years and not one burn.
lines.check_in: {name}, you okay? Show me where it got you, quick.
lines.blame: Somebody ruined the act in there, and it wasn't me. I hit every cue.
lines.thank: You saved my life, {carnal|carnala}! Next show's free for you, front row.
lines.brush_off: That's what I'm here for, {carnal|carnala}. Now you have to clap.
lines.worry: {name}, you scared me, {carnal|carnala}! Sit down, let me see you.
lines.handed_down: Órale, I'm wearing your gear now! I'll make it look good, I promise.
lines.hand_fine: Keep it, {carnal|carnala}, it looks better on you. I've got my lamp oil.
lines.hand_sulk: Hey, that was mine, {carnal|carnala}, and I didn't get a say.
lines.turn_friendly: {name}, you're in my crowd now, {carnal|carnala}, the front row. That's for life.
lines.turn_friends: {name}, I'd do my best trick just for you, {carnal|carnala}, no crowd needed. You're my people now.
lines.turn_grating: Not everybody likes the show, and you don't. That's fine, {carnal|carnala}.
lines.turn_rivals: Stay out of my spotlight and we'll be fine. That's all I'm asking.
lines.make_up: {name}, okay, I was a bit much, I know. Let's start over, {carnal|carnala}.
lines.defend: Hey, that's not fair, and I saw it. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: I've lost my best audience with {name} gone home. It's a terrible thing for a performer.
lines.friend_back: {name}'s back, órale! Now I've got somebody to show off for.
lines.common_spanish: You speak Spanish, {carnal|carnala}! Finally somebody who gets my jokes.
lines.common_mexico: You're from Mexico? Tell me where, {carnal|carnala}, and I'll tell you why Oaxaca's better.
